artist.name: Aishwarya Manikarnike
artist.briefBio: An ‘A’-Grade Veena Artist of All India Radio and Vidwat Antima rank-holding vocalist, Aishwarya Manikarnike has been immersed in artistic tradition within a musical family since childhood. She rejoices in Carnatic Music on the majestic Saraswati Veena and through sparkling vocals.

fullBio.content: ‘A’-Grade Veena Artist (AIR) | Vidwat Antima Rank-Holding Vocalist

Rejoicing in the majesty of the Saraswati Veena and the brilliance of Carnatic vocals, Aishwarya Manikarnike is a multifaceted artiste representing the third generation of a distinguished musical lineage. Nurtured from a tender age by a family of celebrated musicians, she has spent over a decade establishing herself as a prolific Vainika and Vocalist, bridging traditional roots with a contemporary professional career as a Data Engineer.

Aishwarya’s foundation was laid under the rigorous tutelage of her grandmother, Karnataka Kalashree Veena Vid. Smt. M. K. Saraswathi (A-Top Grade, AIR), known for her mastery of the Gayaki style. Her training has been further enriched by her mother, Vid. Smt. Rajyashree Josyer Shrikanth (A-Grade, AIR), and her uncle, violinist Vid. G. Venkatesha Josyer. Currently, she continues her vocal advanced training under the esteemed Sangeetha Kalarathna Vid. M. S. Sheela, while also receiving guidance from mridangist Gaanakala Vid. H. S. Sudhindra and exploring Hindustani vocals under Smt. Geetha Hegde.

Aishwarya is a rare talent who holds high-level credentials in both voice and instrument. A milestone in her career was her 2024 elevation to ‘A’-Grade in Veena by All India Radio, following a series of national competition wins. Her academic prowess is equally notable; she secured the 3rd Rank at the State level in the Vidwat Antima examinations. Her contributions have been recognized with several prestigious awards, including:

items: Best Instrumentalist – The Madras Music Academy (Spirit of Youth)
Raga Laya Prabha Award – Sri Rama Lalitha Kala Mandira, Bengaluru
SAMA Yuva Puraskara – SAMA Arts Foundation
CCRT Scholarships – Awarded by the Indian Ministry of Culture (Junior and Young Artiste schemes)

fullBio.content: Aishwarya’s performance career is highlighted by a historic appearance at the Rashtrapati Bhavan on Republic Day 2025, performing in the presence of the President and Prime Minister of India. As a soloist and a member of a unique Three-Generation Veena Trio alongside her mother and grandmother, she has graced premier stages including the Music Academy Chennai (HCL Series), Bangalore Gayana Samaja, Udupi Sri Krishna Temple, and TTD Nadaneerajanam.

A specialist in the complex Ragam-Tanam-Pallavi (RTP) form, she has won top honors at the Bangalore Gayana Samaja and SRLKM Pallavi Sammela, where she is acclaimed for presenting intricate Pallavis in challenging talas and scales.

Whether through the resonant strings of the Saraswati Veena or her "sparkling" vocal delivery, Aishwarya’s music is a testament to a lifetime of devotion. By balancing her career in technology with her classical pursuits, she aspires to preserve and carry forward the vast treasure of Carnatic Classical art for generations to come.

items.question: What styles of music do you perform?
items.answer: I specialize in Carnatic classical music, performing both on the Veena and as a vocalist. My repertoire includes traditional compositions, ragam tanam pallavi, and devotional music.

items.question: Do you offer music lessons?
items.answer: Yes, I offer private lessons for both Veena and Carnatic vocal music. Lessons are available both in-person and online. Please contact me for more details about availability and scheduling.

items.question: How can I book you for a performance?
items.answer: For performance bookings, please use the contact form on this website or reach out via email. I perform at concerts, festivals, private events, and cultural programs.

items.question: What is the 3 Generation Veena Trio?
items.answer: The 3 Generation Veena Trio is a unique ensemble featuring three generations of Veena artists from my family. This rare collaboration showcases the continuity and evolution of the Veena tradition across generations.

items.question: Where can I listen to your music?
items.answer: You can find my performances on YouTube, and recordings are available on major music streaming platforms. Check the Music section of this website for featured videos.
